_note: Draft interview fixture answers for lets-craft's Phase 3.5 ask seam (src/ask.ts, src/fixtures.ts). The pre-craft interview question flow itself is not implemented yet (Phase 4) -- this is a skeleton: a catch-all "default" so headless runs never hang, plus a handful of representative "match" rules guessed from the plan/spec's known question topics (feature name, worktree, goal, constraints, success criteria, plan/land confirmations). Update the "match" patterns once Phase 4/6's actual question wording exists, and add more once-consumed rules for any question that must be answered differently on repeat visits.
